description: Compare live Indian product prices, stock, and delivery ETAs from the terminal, then keep the history locally.

novel_features.name: Price and availability history
novel_features.description: Query local observations to see price, stock, rating, and availability movement over time.

novel_features.name: Observation diff
novel_features.description: Show the field-level changes between the latest saved observations.

novel_features.name: Fastest available delivery
novel_features.description: Rank currently available delivery options while preserving closed or unparseable platforms.

novel_features.name: Credit-aware request planner
novel_features.description: Calculate fan-out credit cost and affordability before making paid platform requests.

novel_features.name: Manual mirror ingestion
novel_features.description: Persist real QuickCommerce command responses and metadata into the local SQLite mirror.

novel_features.name: Stale-observation report
novel_features.description: Find saved product and ETA observations that are older than a chosen trust window.

novel_features.name: Local platform/location coverage
novel_features.description: Report observed, missing, and stale platform coverage for a location.

novel_features.name: Price-per-unit value view
novel_features.description: Compare price per unit from explicit pack quantities without guessing missing units.
